description: Complete China OpenStreetMap extract used to derive power facilities.
download_instructions: Snapshot date 2026-07-16 verified from PBF header (2026-07-16T20:21:30Z). A different latest snapshot is rejected; register its date in version and local_path.

description: Unit- and phase-level global power project records.
download_instructions: Manual: open the GEM page, select Download data, complete the official form, and save the workbook under data/ using its original or configured filename.

description: Project-level global energy storage database export.
download_instructions: Manual: open the Sandia GESDB project page, accept its terms of use, export projects to JSON, and save the file under data/storage/ using its original or configured filename.

description: China provincial synthetic hourly load workbook.
download_instructions: Automatic: prepare resolves Data output.xlsx through the Figshare article API and downloads it.

description: UN-adjusted one-kilometre population raster for spatial load weighting.
download_instructions: Automatic: prepare downloads the GeoTIFF directly from the WorldPop file index.

description: ERA5 China cutout containing weather fields required for wind, solar, and runoff profiles.
download_instructions: API: accept the ERA5 licence, configure ~/.cdsapirc, then run RawDataManager.prepare('era5_china_2024'); atlite submits serial monthly requests and validates the completed cutout.

description: Original province boundary GeoJSON before geometry cleaning.
download_instructions: Automatic: prepare downloads the original province GeoJSON; geometry cleaning belongs to the standard data layer.

description: Fixed- and floating-foundation offshore wind technical-potential polygons for China from the World Bank ESMAP East Asia and Pacific archive.
download_instructions: Automatic: prepare downloads the CC BY 4.0 regional Shapefile archive; spatial standardization filters ISO_Ter1=CHN and dissolves both foundation zones into one marine zone.

description: China 200-nautical-mile EEZ geometry from Marine Regions World EEZ v12; overlapping-claim records are excluded.
download_instructions: Automatic: prepare queries the official Marine Regions WFS for sovereign code CHN and pol_type=200NM. Use as a reproducible modelling boundary, not as an adjudication of disputed maritime claims.

description: Upstream technology-data cost, efficiency, lifetime, and carbon-intensity assumptions for 2025.
download_instructions: Automatic: prepare downloads the commit-pinned outputs/costs_2025.csv from the official PyPSA technology-data repository.

provider: Dispa-SET NREL and curated generic assumptions
description: Long-form UC storage and reliability assumptions not supplied by PyPSA technology-data.
download_instructions: Repository input: add only non-duplicate model assumptions and retain row-level provenance.

description: Numeric line and transformer parameters exported from pandapower built-in standard types.
download_instructions: Repository snapshot: regenerate from pandapower.std_types basic_line_std_types, basic_trafo_std_types, and basic_trafo3w_std_types when upgrading pandapower.

provider: National Bureau of Statistics and local development and reform commissions
description: Official 2025 coal and local non-residential pipeline-gas price observations with thermal-unit conversions.
download_instructions: Repository input: update from official NBS and local DRC publications; preserve geography, user class, and validity dates.

description: Voltage-level overhead-line impedance proxies with explicit interpolation and proxy quality labels.
download_instructions: Repository input: preserve the OPAL-RT reference, row-level quality, derivation notes, and voltage scope.

description: Authorized China Electric Power Statistics Yearbook used for official comparisons.
download_instructions: Manual: obtain the authorized 2024 yearbook PDF from the publisher, CEC, or an institutional library and save it under data/ using its original or configured filename.
Configure ~/.cdsapirc, accept the ERA5 licence, then run RawDataManager.prepare('era5_china_2025').

provider: GridX synthetic scenario; NEA and CEC growth rates
description: Synthetic 31-province hourly loads based on the 2024 Figshare profile: 2025 annual energy +5.0%; 2026 +5.5% year-on-year (CEC forecast midpoint). Not observed 2025/2026 hourly data.
download_instructions: Locally generated scenario workbook. Preserve the Method and Scaling sheets. Remove Feb 29 from the 2024 profile; normalize each province to its full 2024 energy before applying cumulative multipliers 1.05 and 1.10775. See Method for sources and limitations.

description: Manually curated storage projects with record-level sources and observation dates.
download_instructions: Repository input. Preserve stable source_uid values and record evidence URLs for each row.
